kakao.note: Daum Search, official Kakao Developers API. Free with quotas. Register an app at developers.kakao.com.

naver.note: Official Naver Search Open API, about 25,000 calls a day per app. Register at developers.naver.com.

kagi.note: Pay as you go, about $12 per 1,000 searches. Experimental.

youcom.note: You.com Search API. Needs a key from you.com/platform. Experimental.

yacy.note: Peer-to-peer search. Use your own node.
